answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 17006 Country: India Title: Askum. Can intrests recived from the bank can it be given to mouzin? Question: Askum. Can intrests recived from the bank can it be given to mouzin? Answer ID: 17006 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2006/1595/D=1430) It cannot be given as salary, however if that poor man is entitled for Zakah it can be given to him without the intention of reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
